name: Maurer Rose
desc: A Maurer rose weaves 360 straight chords across a drifting r=sin(nθ) rose into a perpetually morphing star-lattice / celtic-knot filigree, hue-gradient neon threads glowing over a faint filled bloom; renders as spectral lattice, gold-leaf foil, electric neon, cyan blueprint schematic, or dry sumi ink.

petals.doc: rose petal frequency n (base; drifts on K.t)

step.doc: Maurer degree step d (base; drifts on K.t) — the lattice identity

scale.doc: figure radius / how much of the frame the rose fills

hue.doc: base palette hue (start of the spectral gradient)
